hostname_factify2.classifier: majority label per host, fitted on train; an unseen host gets the train majority (Insufficient_Multimodal)
hostname_factify2.note: Per class always (CLAUDE.md, Factify2 rule 3). The source-disjoint train split holds 15 usable Refute records, so a trained classifier's Refute recall is near 0 by construction.

m4fc_source_audit.large_org_rule: at least 10 true and 10 false records, out of sample, over train and val
m4fc_source_audit.language_source: claim_language and fc_language from raw M4FC.json, filtered to the train and val records' ids on load; no field of a test row is used

muse.adaptation: trained on M4FC train (NewsCLIPpings is not held); VERITE gets image-caption similarity only (no date, no evidence); M4FC's evidence is the text side's dated retrieval, its top five titles; no evidence image; class weights balanced

mlp.loss: BCE with logits, pos_weight = negatives / positives
mlp.selection: balanced accuracy on a 15% stratified holdout of train
